messages:
Elliot: Quick heads-up — casual potluck in the kitchen tomorrow 11:30am to celebrate @Juno's promotion to Engineering Manager and a little baby name reveal! :tada: Bring something savory if you can.
calendar-bot: Event created: 'Juno celebration' — Tomorrow 11:30am @ Kitchen — RSVP here: https://calendar.example/evt/12345
Juno: omg you remembered 😭❤️ not a wedding, just baby (2 weeks old!) and the promo is real. no pressure on food, come as you are. thinking of doing a 'guess the name' jar for fun.
Samir: Congrats @Juno!!! :tada: so happy for you both
Tess: two celebrations in one week? love this. i'll bring samosas :yum:
Li: i'll bring gluten-free mac & cheese (yes it's a thing). can someone please put a little GF sign on it?
Maya: made a tiny poll for contributions — reply with the letter you want to bring: a) samosas b) gf mac c) roast veg d) salad e) dessert
Elliot: i'll throw in a cooler of drinks and some platters. also added a 'surprise cookie box' from downtown bakery.
kitchen-bot: Fridge space reserved 11:00-13:00 for event: Juno celebration
Li: ditto on the GF sign. i'll bring sticky notes + a marker.
Samir: i'll bring dessert (mini cheesecakes). also making a 1-slide "Congrats Juno" meme — low effort, high spirit :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Tess: voting: a) samosas — locking in
Maya: Poll results so far — 9 votes: a) samosas 4, b) gf mac 2, c) roast veg 1, d) salad 1, e) dessert 1
Juno: you all are the best. no speeches pls, just hugs. tiny note — if anyone wants to guess the name in advance, put a slip in the jar. bonus points for rhymes. :)
Elliot: we'll do a 2-min 'cheers' moment, otherwise it's chill.
Samir: will anyone livestream for remote folks? i can set up a quick meet link
Maya: +1 for a meet link — added: https://meet.example/room/juno-cheers
Tess: i can drive some folks in from SoMa, carpool? seats for 3
Li: baby pic dropped in thread (link): https://img.example/juno-baby-01.jpg — warning: maximum adorable levels
Juno: tiny baby yawn clip incoming later, you'll all be ruined for productivity tomorrow.
Elliot: see you all at 11:30. thank you team :heart:
